name: An Audience with the King
summary: At Stormwind Keep, the Defias report comes before the Crown. After a long inquiry through Westfall and the Deadmines, you bring City Architect Baros Alexston's findings to the capital.

sections.title: A Royal Summons
sections.body: Edwin VanCleef has fallen, and the conspiracy beneath Moonbrook is broken. City Architect Baros Alexston prepares an official report for the Crown. He believes you should be honored for ending the guild's criminal enterprise. So you carry the findings across Stormwind's grand canals to Stormwind Keep, expecting to meet the realm's ruler.

sections.title: An Empty Throne
sections.body: Lady Katrana Prestor receives the report in the royal court, but King Varian Wrynn is absent. She says he is away on an extended diplomatic mission and cannot congratulate you in person. Prestor accepts the findings and praises you for saving Stormwind from VanCleef's schemes. Then she offers a reward in the king's name. The truth of the uprising remains hidden behind her account of the king's absence.

faq.q: Why am I delivering this report instead of Baros Alexston?
faq.answer: Baros Alexston believes you earned the honor through your work in the field. You tracked the Defias conspiracy through Westfall and stormed the Deadmines, so he asks you to present the findings and receive the Crown's recognition.
King Varian Wrynn is absent from Stormwind Keep. The court says he is away on a secret diplomatic mission, leaving his young son Anduin on the throne under Highlord Bolvar Fordragon's regency.

faq.q: Who actually takes the Defias report?
aliases: who do i talk to in keep
faq.answer: Lady Katrana Prestor receives the report in the royal court. The chief adviser to the throne accepts Baros Alexston's findings, praises you for defeating Edwin VanCleef, and gives you a reward on behalf of the Crown.

faq.q: Does this quest end the Defias Brotherhood questline?
aliases: is this the last defias quest
faq.answer: Yes. The report brings the Defias story, from early Westfall through the Deadmines, to its formal political conclusion.

faq.q: Why does Lady Katrana Prestor seem so dismissive of the king's absence?
faq.answer: Lady Katrana Prestor remains composed in the royal court. She says King Varian is away on distant state business, easing concern about the Crown's whereabouts.

faq.q: What happens to the Defias Brotherhood after this?
faq.answer: Edwin VanCleef is dead, and the brotherhood's great juggernaut project has been thwarted, leaving its leadership shattered. Scattered brigands and remnants still plague Westfall, Redridge, and Stormwind's alleys.

angles.text: For the Alliance, delivering this report ends one of the greatest internal crises to threaten its chief human kingdom.
As a human of Stormwind, this audience avenges the terror across Westfall and reveals how fragile the kingless realm has become.
As a rogue, reporting VanCleef's downfall at the seat of power shows how thin the line can be between a royal operative and an outlaw guildmaster.
